full_judgment:
Salma Masud Chowdhury J: This Rule, arising out of an application under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure at the instance of the accused petitioners, was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the proceeding of Special Case No. 33 of 2008 arising out of Chakaria Police Station Case No. 13 dated 15-3-2008 corresponding to GR Case No. 33 of 2008 under sections 143, 447, 427, 506 and 109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947, now pending in the Court of Divisional Special Judge, Chittagong, should not be quashed and/or pass such other or further order or orders as to this Court may seem fit and proper. 

 3. On conclusion of the investigation, charge sheet was submitted on 19-10-2008 against the accused persons under sections 143/447/427/506/109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947.
